mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses equity discount rates and increases risk appetite, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 24-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 40% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 36-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 signals accelerating manufacturing output, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth above 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 36-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index exceeding 240.0 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240.0, or Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 40% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 36-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as valuation multiples contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 24-month rolling window.
